tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Search the SkillAgent catalogue of AI agent skills, rules files and MCP servers. Returns matching skills with description, format, stars, quality score, freshness, page URL and install command.

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Get one skill as Markdown: summary, metadata, install command and the full skill file. `owner` and `name` are the last two segments of a skill's pageUrl (https://skillagent.dev/skill/{owner}/{name}).

tools.name: recommend_skills
tools.description: Recommend skills for a project from a description of it: languages, frameworks or dependencies (e.g. names from package.json or requirements.txt), a task, and the agent the user runs.
